title: Identification of most representative hub-genes for diagnosis, prognosis, and therapies of hepatocellular carcinoma.
authors: Hossen, Md Alim; Reza, Md Selim; Rana, Md Masud; Hossen, Md Bayazid; Shoaib, Muhammad; Mollah, Md Nurul Haque; Han, Chunsheng
one_liner_zh: 该文通过生物信息学筛选肝癌hub基因及调控网络，仅提及转录因子调控，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is the third leading cause of cancer-related deaths globally. To reduce HCC-related mortality, early diagnosis and therapeutic improvement are essential. Hub differentially expressed genes (HubGs) may serve as potential diagnostic and prognostic biomarkers, also offering therapeutic targets for precise therapies. Therefore, we aimed to identify top-ranked hub genes for the diagnosis, prognosis, and therapy of HCC. METHODS: Through a systematic literature review, 202 HCC-related HubGs were derived from 59 studies, yet consistent detection across these was lacking. Then, we identified top-ranked HubGs (tHubGs) by integrated bioinformatics analysis, highlighting their functions, pathways, and regulators that might be more representative of the diagnosis, prognosis, and therapies of HCC. RESULTS: In this study, eight HubGs (CDK1, AURKA, CDC20, CCNB2, TOP2A, PLK1, BUB1B, and BIRC5) were identified as the tHubGs through the protein-protein interaction (PPI) network and survival analysis. Their differential expression in different stages of HCC, validated using The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) Program database, suggests their potential as early HCC markers. The enrichment analyses revealed some important roles in HCC-related biological processes (BPs), molecular functions (MFs), cellular components (CCs), and signaling pathways. Moreover, the gene regulatory network analysis highlighted key transcription factors (TFs) and microRNAs (miRNAs) that regulate these tHubGs at transcriptional and post-transcriptional. Finally, we selected three drugs (CD437, avrainvillamide, and LRRK2-IN-1) as candidate drugs for HCC treatment as they showed strong binding with all of our proposed and published protein receptors. CONCLUSIONS: The findings of this study may provide valuable resources for early diagnosis, prognosis, and therapies for HCC.
abstract_zh: 背景：肝细胞癌（HCC）是全球癌症相关死亡的第三大原因。为降低HCC相关死亡率，早期诊断和治疗改进至关重要。核心差异表达基因（HubGs）可能作为潜在的诊断和预后生物标志物，也为精准治疗提供治疗靶点。因此，我们旨在识别用于HCC诊断、预后和治疗的前列核心基因。方法：通过系统性文献综述，从59项研究中获得202个HCC相关HubGs，但这些研究间缺乏一致的检测。随后，我们通过整合生物信息学分析识别前列HubGs（tHubGs），强调其功能、通路和调控因子，这些可能更能代表HCC的诊断、预后和治疗。结果：在本研究中，通过蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络和生存分析，八个HubGs（CDK1、AURKA、CDC20、CCNB2、TOP2A、PLK1、BUB1B和BIRC5）被确定为tHubGs。它们在HCC不同阶段的差异表达，使用癌症基因组图谱（TCGA）计划数据库验证，表明其作为早期HCC标志物的潜力。富集分析揭示了它们在HCC相关生物过程（BPs）、分子功能（MFs）、细胞组分（CCs）和信号通路中的重要角色。此外，基因调控网络分析突出了调控这些tHubGs在转录和转录后水平的关键转录因子（TFs）和微小RNA（miRNAs）。最后，我们选择了三种药物（CD437、avrainvillamide和LRRK2-IN-1）作为HCC治疗的候选药物，因为它们与我们提出和已发表的蛋白受体均表现出强结合。结论：本研究的发现可能为HCC的早期诊断、预后和治疗提供宝贵资源。
